UI_AMS_EnableThermalModel_tooltip: Insulating gear that traps body heat slows endurance recovery and makes exertion cost more.
UI_AMS_EnableMuscleStrainModel_tooltip: Heavy gear on the arms and shoulders increases muscle strain when swinging melee weapons.
UI_AMS_EnableSleepPenaltyModel_tooltip: Sleeping in stiff gear such as armor and pads slows fatigue recovery.
UI_AMS_Help_Overview: Overview: The Burden tab shows what your worn gear costs you right now, compared to wearing nothing. The line at the top is the one thing worth knowing.
UI_AMS_Help_Burden: Load: How heavy your gear is for your body. Mass on the legs, feet and arms counts more than mass on the torso, and stiff or bulky gear adds to it. Heavier and stronger characters carry the same gear more easily. The kg figure is the effective load after that weighting.
UI_AMS_Help_Thermal: Heat: Insulating gear traps body heat. When you are running hot, recovery slows everywhere, including at rest, and exertion costs more. Heat clears once you cool down or take the gear off. In the cold, the same gear keeps you warm.
UI_AMS_Help_Breathing: Breathing: Gas masks, respirators and sealed suits make hard exertion cost more endurance. Walking and resting are unaffected.
UI_AMS_Help_Sleep: Sleep: Sleeping in stiff gear such as armor and pads slows how fast sleep clears fatigue. Take it off before bed.
UI_AMS_Help_ExportTitleDesc: Support Reports: If something feels wrong, save a snapshot of your loadout, burden calculations, mod list and game state to a text file, and attach it when reporting a problem.
UI_AMS_Help_Endurance: Endurance: Load makes every exertion cost more and slows recovery: a little while standing, more while walking. Very heavy loads drain endurance even at a walk. Sitting recovers normally unless heat is building up.
UI_AMS_Help_ExportTooltip: Save a support report with your loadout, burden calculations, mod list and game state.
UI_AMS_Load_UnderAllowance: Within the %1 kg that everyday clothing gets for free.
UI_AMS_Heat_Trapping: Trapping heat: recovery %1 even at rest. Slow down or shed layers.
UI_AMS_Heat_Insulating: Your layers are holding in heat against the cold.
UI_AMS_Heat_WellInsulated: Well insulated: traps heat in warm weather.
UI_AMS_Breathing_Detail: Hard work costs extra endurance. Walking and resting are free.
UI_AMS_Melee_SlowStrain: Swings %1 slower and your arms tire faster.
UI_AMS_Melee_Strain: Your arms tire faster when swinging.
UI_AMS_Sleep_Detail: Recovery %1. Take stiff gear off for bed.
UI_AMS_Gear_AllLight: Nothing you wear is heavy enough to stand out.
UI_AMS_Verdict_DrainsWalking: Too heavy to recover endurance even at a walk.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Overheating: You are overheating in this gear.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Extreme: Extreme load. Every run costs you dearly.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Heavy: Heavy load. Expect to stop and catch your breath.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Breathing: Your mask makes hard work exhausting.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Warm: Your gear is holding in heat.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Moderate: Noticeable load. You tire faster on the move.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Light: Light load. You will barely notice it.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Sleep: Easy to move in, but not to sleep in.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Warm_Good: Your clothes are keeping you warm.
UI_AMS_Verdict_Free: Your gear costs you nothing extra.
UI_AMS_Help_Melee: Melee: Heavy arm and hand armor slows your swings, and armored arms tire faster in a fight.
UI_AMS_Help_Map: Body Map: Shows where the weight sits. Hover a gear row to see only that item, hover Load, Melee, Breathing or Sleep to see the gear behind it, or hover a body part to highlight the gear on it.
UI_AMS_Help_Gear: Heaviest Gear: The worn items that add the most effective load, heaviest first. Matching left and right pieces share a row. When one item matters most, the tab tells you what taking it off would change.
UI_AMS_Heat_Building: Trapping heat. Slow down or shed layers.
